verses.he: אֲנִ֤י הַגֶּ֙בֶר֙ רָאָ֣ה עֳנִ֔י בְּשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: I am the man that hath seen affliction By the rod of His wrath.
He hath led me and caused me to walk in darkness and not in light.

verses.he: אַ֣ךְ בִּ֥י יָשֻׁ֛ב יַהֲפֹ֥ךְ יָד֖וֹ כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.en: Surely against me He turneth His hand again and again all the day.
My flesh and my skin hath He worn out; He hath broken my bones.
He hath builded against me, and compassed me With gall and travail.
He hath made me to dwell in dark places, As those that have been long dead. .

verses.he: גָּדַ֧ר בַּעֲדִ֛י וְלֹ֥א אֵצֵ֖א הִכְבִּ֥יד נְחָשְׁתִּֽי׃
verses.en: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot go forth; He hath made my chain heavy.

verses.he: גַּ֣ם כִּ֤י אֶזְעַק֙ וַאֲשַׁוֵּ֔עַ שָׂתַ֖ם תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.en: Yea, when I cry and call for help, He shutteth out my prayer.
He hath enclosed my ways with hewn stone, He hath made my paths crooked.

verses.he: דֹּ֣ב אֹרֵ֥ב הוּא֙ לִ֔י אריה [אֲרִ֖י] בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים׃
verses.en: He is unto me as a bear lying in wait, As a lion in secret places.
He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; He hath made me desolate.
He hath bent His bow, and set me As a mark for the arrow.
He hath caused the arrows of His quiver To enter into my reins.
I am become a derision to all my people, And their song all the day.
He hath filled me with bitterness, He hath sated me with wormwood.
He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, He hath made me to wallow in ashes.
And my soul is removed far off from peace, I forgot prosperity.
And I said: ‘My strength is perished, And mine expectation from the LORD.’
Remember mine affliction and mine anguish, The wormwood and the gall.
My soul hath them still in remembrance, And is bowed down within me.
This I recall to my mind, Therefore have I hope.

verses.he: חַֽסְדֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ כִּ֣י לֹא־תָ֔מְנוּ כִּ֥י לֹא־כָל֖וּ רַחֲמָֽיו׃
verses.en: Surely the LORD’S mercies are not consumed, Surely His compassions fail not.
They are new every morning; Great is Thy faithfulness.

verses.he: חֶלְקִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אָמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֔י עַל־כֵּ֖ן אוֹחִ֥יל לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: ’The LORD is my portion’, saith my soul; ‘Therefore will I hope in Him.’
The LORD is good unto them that wait for Him, To the soul that seeketh Him.
It is good that a man should quietly wait For the salvation of the LORD.
It is good for a man that he bear The yoke in his youth.

verses.he: יֵשֵׁ֤ב בָּדָד֙ וְיִדֹּ֔ם כִּ֥י נָטַ֖ל עָלָֽיו׃
verses.en: Let him sit alone and keep silence, Because He hath laid it upon him.

verses.he: יִתֵּ֤ן בֶּֽעָפָר֙ פִּ֔יהוּ אוּלַ֖י יֵ֥שׁ תִּקְוָֽה׃
verses.en: Let him put his mouth in the dust, If so be there may be hope.
Let him give his cheek to him that smiteth him Let him be filled full with reproach.
For the Lord will not cast off For ever.
For though He cause grief, yet will He have compassion According to the multitude of His mercies.

verses.he: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א עִנָּה֙ מִלִּבּ֔וֹ וַיַּגֶּ֖ה בְּנֵי־אִֽישׁ׃
verses.en: For He doth not afflict willingly, Nor grieve the children of men.

verses.he: לְדַכֵּא֙ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל אֲסִ֥ירֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: To crush under foot All the prisoners of the earth,
To turn aside the right of a man Before the face of the Most High,

verses.he: לְעַוֵּ֤ת אָדָם֙ בְּרִיב֔וֹ אֲדֹנָ֖י לֹ֥א רָאָֽה׃
verses.en: To subvert a man in his cause, The Lord approveth not.

verses.he: מִ֣י זֶ֤ה אָמַר֙ וַתֶּ֔הִי אֲדֹנָ֖י לֹ֥א צִוָּֽה׃
verses.en: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, When the Lord commandeth it not?

verses.he: מִפִּ֤י עֶלְיוֹן֙ לֹ֣א תֵצֵ֔א הָרָע֖וֹת וְהַטּֽוֹב׃
verses.en: Out of the mouth of the Most High proceedeth not Evil and good?
Wherefore doth a living man complain, A strong man because of his sins?
Let us search and try our ways, And return to the LORD.
Let us lift up our heart with our hands Unto God in the heavens.

verses.he: נַ֤חְנוּ פָשַׁ֙עְנוּ֙ וּמָרִ֔ינוּ אַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א סָלָֽחְתָּ׃
verses.en: We have transgressed and have rebelled; Thou hast not pardoned.

verses.he: סַכֹּ֤תָה בָאַף֙ וַֽתִּרְדְּפֵ֔נוּ הָרַ֖גְתָּ לֹ֥א חָמָֽלְתָּ׃
verses.en: Thou hast covered with anger and pursued us; Thou hast slain unsparingly.
Thou hast covered Thyself with a cloud, So that no prayer can pass through.
Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse In the midst of the peoples.
All our enemies have opened their mouth Wide against us.

verses.he: פַּ֧חַד וָפַ֛חַת הָ֥יָה לָ֖נוּ הַשֵּׁ֥את וְהַשָּֽׁבֶר׃
verses.en: Terror and the pit are come upon us, Desolation and destruction.
Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water, For the breach of the daughter of my people.

verses.he: עֵינִ֧י נִגְּרָ֛ה וְלֹ֥א תִדְמֶ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין הֲפֻגֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Mine eye is poured out, and ceaseth not, Without any intermission,
Till the LORD look forth, And behold from heaven.

verses.he: עֵינִי֙ עֽוֹלְלָ֣ה לְנַפְשִׁ֔י מִכֹּ֖ל בְּנ֥וֹת עִירִֽי׃
verses.en: Mine eye affected my soul, Because of all the daughters of my city.
They have chased me sore like a bird, That are mine enemies without cause.
They have cut off my life in the dungeon, And have cast stones upon me.
Waters flowed over my head; I said: ‘I am cut off.’
I called upon Thy name, O LORD, Out of the lowest dungeon.

verses.he: קוֹלִ֖י שָׁמָ֑עְתָּ אַל־תַּעְלֵ֧ם אָזְנְךָ֛ לְרַוְחָתִ֖י לְשַׁוְעָתִֽי׃
verses.en: Thou heardest my voice; hide not Thine ear at my sighing, at my cry.
Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon Thee; Thou saidst: ‘Fear not.’ .

verses.he: רַ֧בְתָּ אֲדֹנָ֛י רִיבֵ֥י נַפְשִׁ֖י גָּאַ֥לְתָּ חַיָּֽי׃
verses.en: O Lord, Thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; Thou hast redeemed my life.
O LORD, Thou hast seen my wrong; Judge Thou my cause.
Thou hast seen all their vengeance And all their devices against me.
Thou hast heard their taunt, O LORD, And all their devices against me;
The lips of those that rose up against me, And their muttering against me all the day.
Behold Thou their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song.

verses.he: תָּשִׁ֨יב לָהֶ֥ם גְּמ֛וּל יְהוָ֖ה כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Thou wilt render unto them a recompense, O LORD, According to the work of their hands.
Thou wilt give them hardness of heart, Thy curse unto them.

verses.he: תִּרְדֹּ֤ף בְּאַף֙ וְתַשְׁמִידֵ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת שְׁמֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Thou wilt pursue them in anger, and destroy them From under the heavens of the LORD.
